Photosynthesis

Photosynthesis is a biological process used by plants, algae, and bacteria to convert light energy into chemical energy. It supports food chains, produces oxygen, and stores solar energy in organic compounds.

Overview

Light energy is absorbed by chlorophyll in chloroplasts. Water molecules are split, oxygen is released, and the resulting electrons drive synthesis of compounds used by the Calvin cycle.
